zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把跨境利润、材料AI、单人创作、边境洪灾、关键航道、平台责任、端侧算力与月食连成一张变化图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者今天要同时管理利润结构、决策负荷、基础设施风险与社会信任
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把跨境利润、材料AI、单人创作、边境洪灾、关键航道、平台责任、端侧算力与月食连成一张变化图；经营者今天要同时管理利润结构、决策负荷、基础设施风险与社会信任
zh-CN.intro: PDD增收但净利润下滑，MIT把化学规则前置到材料生成，单人AI影像暴露决策过载；尼中边境洪灾、霍尔木兹临时航道谈判、Meta儿童安全和解、Apple新芯片与深度月偏食补齐风险、平台和科学信号。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正影响经营的不是单条新闻，而是成本、能力、风险和信任如何互相传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先标出今天会改变利润、交付和判断负荷的三件事。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals connect cross-border margins, materials AI, solo creation, border floods, a vital shipping lane, platform responsibility, on-device compute and a lunar eclipse
en-US.headlineView: operators need to manage margin structure, decision load, infrastructure risk and public trust at the same time
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals connect cross-border margins, materials AI, solo creation, border floods, a vital shipping lane, platform responsibility, on-device compute and a lunar eclipse; operators need to manage margin structure, decision load, infrastructure risk and public trust at the same time
en-US.intro: PDD grew revenue while net income fell, MIT moved chemistry constraints ahead of materials generation, and solo AI filmmaking exposed decision overload; Nepal-China border floods, Hormuz corridor talks, Meta's child-safety settlement, new Apple chips and a deep partial lunar eclipse complete the risk, platform and science map.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The operating signal is not one headline, but how cost, capability, risk and trust travel together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Mark the three changes that alter margin, delivery or decision load today.

sources.title: PDD Holdings Announces Second Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

zh-CN.headlineFact: PDD二季度营收1124亿元增长8%，归母净利润272亿元下降12%
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境经营者要把平台投入、合规和流量波动放进单品利润表
zh-CN.headlineFull: PDD二季度营收1124亿元增长8%，归母净利润272亿元下降12%；跨境经营者要把平台投入、合规和流量波动放进单品利润表
zh-CN.intro: PDD Holdings公布二季度营收1124亿元、同比增长8%，归母净利润272亿元、同比下降12%；在全球贸易和监管持续变化时，增长并不自动等于更高利润，卖家应按市场重算获客、履约、退货与合规成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境增长最危险的错觉，是只看GMV上升，不看每一单留下多少现金。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把流量、仓配、退货和合规拆成四行再定价。

en-US.headlineFact: PDD's second-quarter revenue rose 8 percent to RMB112.4 billion while attributable net income fell 12 percent to RMB27.2 billion
en-US.headlineView: cross-border operators should put platform investment, compliance and traffic volatility into SKU-level margins
en-US.headlineFull: PDD's second-quarter revenue rose 8 percent to RMB112.4 billion while attributable net income fell 12 percent to RMB27.2 billion; cross-border operators should put platform investment, compliance and traffic volatility into SKU-level margins
en-US.intro: PDD Holdings reported second-quarter revenue of RMB112.4 billion, up 8 percent, while net income attributable to ordinary shareholders fell 12 percent to RMB27.2 billion; amid shifting trade and regulation, sellers should recalculate acquisition, fulfillment, returns and compliance by market.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The dangerous illusion in cross-border growth is rising GMV without knowing the cash left per order.
en-US.doudouQuote: Split traffic, fulfillment, returns and compliance into four lines before repricing.

sources.title: PDD Holdings Announces Second Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

zh-CN.headlineFact: MIT发布CrysVCD框架，把化学价态约束放到材料生成前端
zh-CN.headlineView: 生成式AI的下一步不是产出更多候选，而是减少昂贵的无效筛选
zh-CN.headlineFull: MIT发布CrysVCD框架，把化学价态约束放到材料生成前端；生成式AI的下一步不是产出更多候选，而是减少昂贵的无效筛选
zh-CN.intro: MIT团队把语言模型与扩散模型结合，先生成满足关键化学规则的配方，再构建晶体结构；论文显示近70%的计算材料通过严格晶格动力学稳定性测试，并可面向芯片散热等目标属性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当验证占掉九成成本，最有价值的AI不是更会想象，而是更早排除不可能。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先让化学规则进门，再让模型画一百万种材料。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: MIT introduced CrysVCD, moving chemical valence constraints to the front of materials generation
en-US.headlineView: the next step for generative AI is reducing expensive invalid screening, not producing more candidates
en-US.headlineFull: MIT introduced CrysVCD, moving chemical valence constraints to the front of materials generation; the next step for generative AI is reducing expensive invalid screening, not producing more candidates
en-US.intro: MIT researchers combined a language model with diffusion generation so chemically valid formulas come before crystal structures; nearly 70 percent of generated candidates passed a stringent lattice-dynamics stability test, with target properties including chip-cooling performance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When validation consumes most of the cost, the best AI rules out impossibility earlier.
en-US.doudouQuote: Invite chemistry in before asking the model for a million materials.

sources.title: AI helps design new materials that work in the real world

zh-CN.headlineFact: 一名单人AI电影创作者公开拆解角色叠加与决策过载的运营成本
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司真正的杠杆来自锁定参考、按任务批处理和可重复节奏
zh-CN.headlineFull: 一名单人AI电影创作者公开拆解角色叠加与决策过载的运营成本；一人公司真正的杠杆来自锁定参考、按任务批处理和可重复节奏
zh-CN.intro: 案例指出，AI把剧组压进一台电脑，却没有消除布景、灯光、服装、剪辑与连续性判断；作者通过锁定角色和色彩参考、按任务而非场景批处理，并设定稳定产出节奏来降低切换成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI能缩小团队规模，却不会自动缩小需要做出的决定数量。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把重复判断变成模板，才能把脑力留给真正的创作。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: A solo AI filmmaker documented the operating cost of stacked roles and decision overload
en-US.headlineView: real one-person-company leverage comes from locked references, task batching and a repeatable pace
en-US.headlineFull: A solo AI filmmaker documented the operating cost of stacked roles and decision overload; real one-person-company leverage comes from locked references, task batching and a repeatable pace
en-US.intro: The case shows that AI compresses a film crew into a laptop without removing set, lighting, costume, editing and continuity decisions; the creator reduced switching costs by locking character and color references, batching by task and keeping a deliberately steady release rhythm.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI can shrink the team without automatically shrinking the number of decisions.
en-US.doudouQuote: Turn repeated choices into templates and save judgment for the work that matters.

sources.title: How to Avoid Burnout as a Solo AI Filmmaker: The System I Built for Lost Garden

zh-CN.headlineFact: 尼泊尔公共广播称博特科西突发洪灾已确认95人死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 高山边境的洪灾风险会同时切断居民安全、道路、口岸和跨境供应
zh-CN.headlineFull: 尼泊尔公共广播称博特科西突发洪灾已确认95人死亡；高山边境的洪灾风险会同时切断居民安全、道路、口岸和跨境供应
zh-CN.intro: Radio Nepal报道，拉苏瓦地区突发洪水的确认死亡人数升至95人；灾害冲击尼泊尔与中国接壤的山谷和交通节点，搜救仍在继续，人员、道路与贸易通道损失需要持续更新。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 边境基础设施不是一条路，而是生命、救援与贸易共同依赖的脆弱链条。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先保人，再恢复桥、路和通信。

en-US.headlineFact: Nepal's public broadcaster reported 95 confirmed deaths in the Bhotekoshi flash flood
en-US.headlineView: a high-mountain border flood can sever safety, roads, crossings and cross-border supply at once
en-US.headlineFull: Nepal's public broadcaster reported 95 confirmed deaths in the Bhotekoshi flash flood; a high-mountain border flood can sever safety, roads, crossings and cross-border supply at once
en-US.intro: Radio Nepal reported that the confirmed death toll from the flash flood in Rasuwa district had reached 95; search and rescue continued as damage across valleys and transport nodes near the China border disrupted people, roads and trade routes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Border infrastructure is a fragile chain shared by lives, rescue and trade.
en-US.doudouQuote: Protect people first, then restore bridges, roads and communications.

sources.title: 95 confirmed dead in Bhotekoshi flash flood

zh-CN.headlineFact: 伊朗与阿曼讨论在霍尔木兹海峡建立联合临时航道并开展排雷
zh-CN.headlineView: 能源与航运市场正在提前交易缓和预期，但安全通航仍取决于执行细节
zh-CN.headlineFull: 伊朗与阿曼讨论在霍尔木兹海峡建立联合临时航道并开展排雷；能源与航运市场正在提前交易缓和预期，但安全通航仍取决于执行细节
zh-CN.intro: 双方提出联合临时航道、共同排雷、交通管理和信息交换框架，并将继续技术谈判；对航运商而言，宣布框架不等于风险消失，保险、绕行和交付承诺仍需按实际通航验证。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 航道协议的价值，不在标题里的开放，而在船只是否能安全、稳定、可预测地通过。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看第一艘船怎么走，再改运价表。

en-US.headlineFact: Iran and Oman discussed a joint temporary corridor and mine-clearing project in the Strait of Hormuz
en-US.headlineView: energy and shipping markets are pricing de-escalation early, but safe passage still depends on execution
en-US.headlineFull: Iran and Oman discussed a joint temporary corridor and mine-clearing project in the Strait of Hormuz; energy and shipping markets are pricing de-escalation early, but safe passage still depends on execution
en-US.intro: The proposal covers a joint temporary navigation corridor, mine clearance, traffic management and information exchange, with technical talks continuing; shippers should keep insurance, routing and delivery promises tied to verified vessel movement rather than headlines alone.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A corridor matters when ships can pass safely, consistently and predictably.
en-US.doudouQuote: Watch how the first ship moves before changing the freight sheet.

sources.title: Oman, Iran discuss proposed framework to establish joint temporary navigational corridor through Strait of Hormuz

zh-CN.headlineFact: Meta同意支付逾170亿美元并对Instagram与Facebook实施儿童安全改革
zh-CN.headlineView: 平台责任正从原则声明进入产品设计、审计与长期资金约束
zh-CN.headlineFull: Meta同意支付逾170亿美元并对Instagram与Facebook实施儿童安全改革；平台责任正从原则声明进入产品设计、审计与长期资金约束
zh-CN.intro: 科罗拉多州总检察长宣布，全国性和解要求Meta支付超过170亿美元，并落实面向年轻用户的产品改革；这意味着增长机制、默认设置、验证与审计将越来越直接影响平台成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当产品机制能改变行为，安全就不能只写在使用条款里。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把护栏装进产品，不要只放在公告页。

en-US.headlineFact: Meta agreed to pay more than $17 billion and implement child-safety reforms across Instagram and Facebook
en-US.headlineView: platform responsibility is moving from principles into product design, audits and long-term financial constraints
en-US.headlineFull: Meta agreed to pay more than $17 billion and implement child-safety reforms across Instagram and Facebook; platform responsibility is moving from principles into product design, audits and long-term financial constraints
en-US.intro: Colorado's attorney general announced a nationwide settlement requiring Meta to pay more than $17 billion and implement product reforms for young users; growth mechanics, defaults, verification and audits are becoming direct platform costs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When product mechanics shape behavior, safety cannot live only in the terms page.
en-US.doudouQuote: Build the guardrail into the product, not just the announcement.

sources.title: Attorney General Weiser announces historic settlement with Meta Platforms

zh-CN.headlineFact: Apple发布首款2纳米M6与四晶粒M5 Ultra，强化本地AI计算
zh-CN.headlineView: AI竞争正在从云端模型延伸到个人设备的算力、内存带宽与能效
zh-CN.headlineFull: Apple发布首款2纳米M6与四晶粒M5 Ultra，强化本地AI计算；AI竞争正在从云端模型延伸到个人设备的算力、内存带宽与能效
zh-CN.intro: M6采用12核CPU、12核GPU、双16核神经网络引擎与最高170GB/s统一内存带宽；M5 Ultra面向更重的桌面任务，端侧AI能力开始成为硬件更新的核心叙事。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当模型进入日常工作流，算力的位置会和算力的大小一样重要。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 云端负责大脑，终端开始练肌肉。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：芯片与终端。

en-US.headlineFact: Apple unveiled its first 2-nanometer M6 and a four-die M5 Ultra to expand local AI compute
en-US.headlineView: AI competition is extending from cloud models into device compute, memory bandwidth and efficiency
en-US.headlineFull: Apple unveiled its first 2-nanometer M6 and a four-die M5 Ultra to expand local AI compute; AI competition is extending from cloud models into device compute, memory bandwidth and efficiency
en-US.intro: M6 combines a 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, dual 16-core Neural Engines and up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth, while M5 Ultra targets heavier desktop workloads; on-device AI is becoming central to the hardware upgrade story.
en-US.xiaziQuote: As models enter daily workflows, where compute lives matters as much as how much exists.
en-US.doudouQuote: The cloud holds the brain while devices build muscle.

sources.title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute

zh-CN.headlineFact: 8月27日至28日将出现深度月偏食，食甚时月面96.3%进入地球本影
zh-CN.headlineView: 美洲、西欧和西非观测者将看到接近全食的铜色月面
zh-CN.headlineFull: 8月27日至28日将出现深度月偏食，食甚时月面96.3%进入地球本影；美洲、西欧和西非观测者将看到接近全食的铜色月面
zh-CN.intro: NASA可视化显示，偏食阶段从世界时2:34开始，食甚在4:13，月面有96.3%位于地球本影；此次月食属于沙罗周期138，可见区覆盖大部分美洲、西欧与西非。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 天文事件把全球时区变成同一张观测表，也提醒我们用精确数字描述自然。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 不是全食，却只给月亮留下3.7%的亮边。

en-US.headlineFact: A deep partial lunar eclipse on August 27-28 will place 96.3 percent of the Moon's disk inside Earth's umbra at maximum
en-US.headlineView: observers across the Americas, western Europe and western Africa will see an almost-total copper Moon
en-US.headlineFull: A deep partial lunar eclipse on August 27-28 will place 96.3 percent of the Moon's disk inside Earth's umbra at maximum; observers across the Americas, western Europe and western Africa will see an almost-total copper Moon
en-US.intro: NASA's visualization shows the partial phase beginning at 2:34 UTC and maximum eclipse at 4:13 UTC, with 96.3 percent of the lunar disk inside Earth's umbra; the Saros 138 event is visible across much of the Americas, western Europe and western Africa.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Astronomy turns global time zones into one observing table and rewards precise language.
en-US.doudouQuote: Not total, but only 3.7 percent of the Moon stays bright.
